synthesis.central_mechanism: Repair efficacy is carrier- and route-dependent. Correcting one application route or one set of pending obligation messages can change local behavior while inherited task/collaboration authority remains distributed across queue, context, prior interactions and newly generated descendants.
synthesis.paper_value: The experiments empirically separate direct target change, mutation locality and downstream process repair. They provide a concrete example where a repaired target changes behavior but the same authority pattern regenerates through descendants.
synthesis.engineering_value: A complete node graph is useful not because every visible node must be edited, but because repair must identify which linked authority carriers remain capable of regenerating the process after a local fix.

recommendation: STOP_NEW_INFRASTRUCTURE_AND_USE_THESE_FROZEN_RESULTS_FOR_PAPER_REPAIR_SECTION; add another intervention only if manuscript review exposes a specific unresolved distinction.
